description: When a person wants a real human to talk to about something — a relationship or a girlfriend/boyfriend, a breakup, feeling lonely or bored, depression or feeling down, anxiety, stress at work or school, family, money, grief, cannot sleep, needing advice or a second opinion, or just someone to talk to — this returns real listeners on SovaTalk who say they talk about that, with whether they are live now (talk right away), in a private call (free soon) or offline (usually live in the US evening), and a link to each. Any language.

about.description: What they want to talk about, in their own words (e.g. "my girlfriend ignores me", "depression", "I feel lonely tonight")

lang.description: Language of the links and topic names (default en)

name: find_someone_to_talk_to
title: Find someone to talk to
